title: Unary witness language
statement: Given a language $B$ of Boolean strings, define a language consisting of those Boolean strings $w$ for which there is a natural number $n$ such that $w$ is the length-$n$ string of true bits and there is a string $x$ of length $n$ belonging to $B$.
